name: chip-copy-and-note
description: TASK-20260907T060000 — 칩 툴팁 2문단 · 컴포저 안내 문단 제거 후 하단 정합

steps.name: note-element-gone
steps.script: (() => ({ note: !!document.getElementById('composerActionsSelectorNote'), cssRule: [...document.styleSheets].some(s => { try { return [...s.cssRules].some(r => (r.selectorText||'').includes('composer-actions-note')); } catch (e) { return false; } }) }))()

steps.name: chip-tooltip
steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('aiConnState'); return { state: el.dataset.state, label: el.textContent, title: el.title, paragraphs: (el.title.match(/\n/g)||[]).length + 1, chars: el.title.length }; })()

steps.name: bottom-alignment
steps.script: (() => { const prof = document.querySelector('.sidebar-profile'); const box = document.querySelector('.composer-box'); const wrap = document.querySelector('.composer-wrap'); const r = e => { const b = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return { top: Math.round(b.top), bottom: Math.round(b.bottom), height: Math.round(b.height) }; }; return { profile: r(prof), composerBox: r(box), composerWrap: r(wrap), bottomGap: Math.round(prof.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - box.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) }; })()

steps.name: model-item-visibility
steps.script: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('composerActionsModelItem'); const cat = window.__state && window.__state.modelCatalog; return { modelItemHidden: m ? m.classList.contains('hidden') : null, label: document.getElementById('composerActionsModelLabel')?.textContent || null }; })()
